title: Unconditional full linear convergence and quasi-optimal complexity of smoothed adaptive finite element methods
summary: We present the first rigorous convergence analysis of the smoothed adaptive finite element method (S-AFEM) proposed in [Mulita, Giani, Heltai: SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 43, 2021]. S-AFEM modifies the classical adaptive finite element method (AFEM) by performing accurate discrete solves only on periodically determined mesh levels, while the intermediate levels employ a fixed number of cheap smoothing iterations.
